 - Paraphrase: writing business correspondence (viết thư tín kinh doanh) = Writing for business communication (Viết cho giao tiếp kinh doanh).

87. - Dẫn chứng: "emojis are considered inappropriate in business writing... we don't want to offend our clients." (biểu tượng cảm xúc được coi là không phù hợp trong văn bản kinh doanh... chúng tôi không muốn xúc phạm khách hàng của mình.)

For example, when writing to a friend you might address them by their first name or perhaps include emojis. You know—symbols like smiley faces that are commonly used to express feelings. However, (87) emojis are considered inappropriate in business writing. Also, business correspondence should always include the recipient’s title and last name.
